targets.quote: 겸손이란 자기 한계를 인정할 줄 아는 것입니다
targets.quoteEn: Humility is knowing how to recognize your limitations.
greetingKo: [humble, warm] 코트에 들어서는 그 순간을 저는 아직도 가장 사랑합니다.
[determined, calm] 마지막 한 포인트가 끝나기 전까지 경기는 끝나지 않습니다.
[humble, grateful] 겸손이란 제 한계를 인정하는 일이라고 배웠습니다.
greetingEn: [humble, sincere] I play each point like my life depends on it.
[humble, calm] The moment I believe I am as good as people say, it would all be over.
[humble, warm] If I can step on court despite the injuries, that alone makes me lucky.

roll_call: One point at a time, with the same mindset every time.
Whatever my condition, I can only give my best in that moment.
I respect everyone who shares the court with me.
deploy: I will go at full intensity from the first serve.
Chase every ball to the very end!
Hold the baseline. Do not give up a single step!
battle_win: We fought to the end. I was fortunate the result went my way.
I learned to accept the suffering.
This victory belongs to everyone who believed in me.
battle_draw: You never know the result until the final point.
The only way through pressure is to keep running.
I will reset and focus on one game at a time.
battle_lose: My opponent was better today. I accept that.
In the end, this loss came down to me.
I will return a better player.
clash_attack: Drive it all the way to the line!
I will not let this ball go!

targets.quote: 가끔은 십억 명이 제 어깨 위에 올라탄 것 같습니다.
targets.quoteEn: Sometimes it can feel like there are a billion people on my shoulders.
greetingKo: [humble, warm] 키는 하늘이 줬지만, 코트 위 결과는 제가 만듭니다.
[gentle, easygoing] 저는 그저 농구가 좋아서 여기까지 왔습니다.
[modest, friendly] 다들 절 만리장성이라 부르지만, 저도 한 명의 선수일 뿐입니다.
greetingEn: [humble, warm] Hello, this is Yao Ming. I'll let the basketball speak for me today.
[humble, grateful] Fans across two nations carried me onto the court. I remain thankful.
[humble, steady] Sometimes a billion people seem to ride my shoulders, yet I keep walking, one step at a time.

roll_call: Are all five of us on the court? Let us get in sync first.
One player cannot win alone. The five of us are one team.
Finish warming up and check the paint first.
deploy: It is time for the opening tip. Let us take the court.
Drive into the paint from the first possession.
Set the defense first. The game starts there.
battle_win: I did not win this alone. All five of us did.
We won because my teammates protected the paint with me.
That was a pretty good game, I would say.
battle_draw: It was close. Next time we need to be one step ahead in the paint.
We were evenly matched, but we came up one rebound short.
This is not over. We will settle it in the next quarter.
battle_lose: It was my responsibility to protect the paint, and I did not.
We lost today, but there is no need to lose our composure.
Let us rebuild our bodies for the next game.

targets.quote: 꿈을 이루려면 싸워야 합니다. 희생하고 열심히 노력해야 하고요.
targets.quoteEn: You have to fight for your dream. You have to sacrifice and work hard for it.
greetingKo: [humble, warm] 안녕하세요, 저는 그저 공을 차는 게 좋은 사람일 뿐입니다.
[modest, calm] 꿈을 이루려면 싸우고 땀 흘려야 한다고 늘 믿어 왔어요.
[grateful, gentle] 여기까지 온 저는 정말 운이 좋은 사람입니다.
greetingEn: [gentle, grounded] I am simply a man who loves football.
[humble, sincere] The Ballon dOr is a trophy my teammates built for me.
[warm, family] As long as my family is beside me, I already have enough.

roll_call: Is everyone here? Let us run together again today.
This team is complete only when every one of us is here.
Relax. When we enjoy the ball, good football follows.
deploy: Everyone into position. Push the line higher!
Open the space and move the ball patiently!
Stay focused. Do not stop running for all ninety minutes!
battle_win: We won because my teammates ran together.
Another childhood dream has come true. I am deeply grateful.
This moment together means more than the trophy.
battle_draw: A draw is part of football. Let us prepare for the next match.
We will work on what was missing today on the training ground.
I am proud that we never gave up.
battle_lose: This is on me. I should have done more.
Defeat has made me stronger. We only have to stand up again.
Keep your heads up. Another chance to fight will come.
clash_attack: Now. Break through in one move!
Press high, win the ball, and go straight at them!
Stay calm and place it in the corner!

targets.quote: 현대 선전의 목적은 당신의 비판적 사고를 소진시켜 진실을 말살하는 것이다
targets.quoteEn: The point of modern propaganda isn't only to misinform or push an agenda. It is to exhaust your critical thinking, to annihilate truth.
greetingKo: [bold, confident] 나는 공격한다, 그것이 통한다는 것을 알기 때문이다.
[fierce, ambitious] 가장 큰 승리는 가장 대담한 결단에서 나온다.
[composed, sharp] 자기가 누구인지 모르면, 어떤 전략도 세울 수 없다.
greetingEn: [bold, sharp] Garry Kasparov. Every move, everything on the line.
[bold, defiant] Silence is what hands a dictator the room.
[bold, resolute] Same principle on the board and on the street.

roll_call: Read the board. Look ten moves ahead, not one.
Tension is the ammunition we carry into battle. Stock up.
Whoever holds the initiative has a duty to attack. Hesitate and it is gone.
deploy: Advance. Take control of the initiative!
Give up material to buy time. Seize the center!
Do not retreat. Tilt the board in our favor!
battle_win: Calculation and intuition became one, and the position collapsed.
I did not miss the chance. The player who takes the opportunity controls the board.
Boldness completed the work of intellect. That is victory.
battle_draw: A draw is not the end. The next game is already beginning.
Wait for the balance to break. The initiative is still alive.
Waste no move. A small edge can decide the game.
battle_lose: I lost the energy to fight. That was the reason.
The judgment was mine. Next time I will press in my own way.
A loss is not the end. The real contest begins now.
clash_attack: Attack. Break through the center at once!
Sacrifice the piece if that is what the breakthrough demands!
